subject: general
question: The average weight of P, Q and R is 58 kg. If the average weight of P and Q is 54 kg and that of Q and R is 48 kg, then the weight of Q is:
solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of P, Q and R is 58 kg.

The average weight of P and Q is 54 kg and that of Q and R is 48 kg.

**Concept used:**

Average = Total sum of observations/ Number of observations

**Calculations:**

(P + Q + R) /3 = 58

⇒ P + Q + R = 174 kgs

Now 

(P + Q)/2 = 54

⇒ P + Q = 108

⇒ (Q + R)/2 = 48

⇒ Q + R = 96

Weight of Q = weight of (Q + R) + weight of (P + Q) – weight of (P + Q + R)

⇒ 96 + 108 – (174)

⇒ 204 – 174

⇒ 30 kg

**∴ The correct choice is option 3.**
